name: skills
description: Agent skills for product work: drafting and critiquing PRDs, critiquing specs and implementation plans before execution, and running qualitative user-research interviews.

plugins.name: qualitative-product-research
plugins.description: Qualitative user-research skills: rehearse interviews with a coached roleplay, and get live next-question suggestions during a real interview.

plugins.name: product-development
plugins.description: Turn a product idea into a PRD ready for the spec: get grilled on the idea first, get a product-only draft (what and why), then critique it into proposed edits. Prototype or critique UIs against the Laws of UX. Critique the spec and implementation plan before execution. Step back to check a design is the best way to reach the goal. Rewrite a PR's title and description for a reader with no context. Build a spec end to end: plan, critique, implement, simplify, security-review, PR.
